limitations: This is a freshly bundled Engine/Renderer harness over local HTTP, not a claim that the distribution artifact itself was benchmarked. Artifact hash is recorded for traceability.
Measurements share the cloud Linux instance with other test processes and real-time play runs. RAF includes scheduling; it is not representative Windows hardware.
D and E exercise real WeaponSystem spawn, movement, collision, hit, pooling and rendering; no synthetic projectile array is used.
Brief JS heap observations are not a leak diagnosis. No original-game fidelity or density comparison is implied.
